beats.concept: Getting under way: trimming the sail for the first leg out
beats.gist: Manuel loads the canoa at Trafaria with bread, water and ice for Ti Joaquim's muleta, which is out fishing. He explains that boats like his are how goods and people move on the river, by sail and oars.

beats.concept: Holding a steady course and point of sail
beats.gist: On the long calm leg out, Manuel talks about the work: one word, barca, once covered every small boat. Boats came to differ by job and route, his canoa carries people and small goods, and the river is the busiest road there is.

beats.concept: Approach and dock: controlling speed to come alongside another boat
beats.gist: Short instruction as the canoa closes on the muleta: slow down and come alongside without ramming her.

beats.concept: Approach and dock (acostar): holding position alongside
beats.gist: Once the player is alongside and slow, Ti Joaquim grudgingly approves the approach. The supplies go over, his fish comes across into the canoa, and he says the catch must reach the waterfront fresh.
With the city in view, Manuel says fishing boats like the muletas have long unloaded great quantities of fish here, and an old account speaks of hundreds of boats doing it.

Manuel brings the fish to the Ribeira, the waterfront where boats load and unload all day and goods are traded. From there fish travels on by water, and his canoa is just one small link in that daily traffic.

cast.role: Invented skipper of a small canoa working out of Trafaria under sail and oars, carrying people and small goods across th
cast.voice: Practical, dry, a little impatient with the wind. He speaks in short working sentences and names boats precisely, because he knows sailors mix up their names.
cast.want: To get the supplies out to the muleta and its catch back while the fish is still worth selling.

cast.name: Ti Joaquim (fictional)
cast.role: Invented master of a muleta, a documented Tagus fishing boat type. He stays out fishing and depends on boats from the ri
cast.voice: Gruff and weathered, few words, judges a skipper by how he comes alongside.
cast.want: To keep fishing without losing a day going in, and to see his fish reach the waterfront.
